notes.title: Illyriad News Update - Summer 2025
notes.content: [p]It's an understatement to say that it's been a minute since we've updated our Steam profile. That's the bad news. The good news is that we've been updating the game over the past 2 years and making meaningful improvements and content updates on a major scale. Here's a comprehensive update on everything we've done to improve the game:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Designers & Moderators[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Illyriad's DEVS added GMs Jejune, Duran, and Malek to team, with Jejune working on the designs for the upcoming Faction AI release and lore-related content, Duran taking the lead role as game moderator, and Malek bringing his Illy combat experience to designing and updating new combat systems and content. The new GMs -- all three of which are ex-players -- have bridged the gap between players and DEVS, leadiing the game into a new era of crowdsourced, player-inspired updates and a healthier community.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Cleaned-up Global Chat[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27154998/bed639b260e7858003e41ef5873fcc70f9b231c3.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/duran-shadowfist-named-as-new-illyriad-gm_topic11102_post111041.html?KW=#111041"]GM Duran[/url] has done a fantastic job of [b]cleaning up GC[/b]. Global Chat is a major focus of Illy's user interface, and the community rules are being enforced so that new players can get resources and answers from veterans, with an emphasis on players having fun, eing social, and talking about the game.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patches & Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Lots of bugs were fixed and things updated[/b] last Summer. We had an update in [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/16may24-bugfixes-siege-blockade-occupy_topic11099.htm"]May[/url], on [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/05jun24-bugfixes_topic11117.html"]June 5[/url] and [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/14jun24-bugfixes-diplo-unit-data-comm-gear-etc_topic11118.html"]June 14[/url], and in [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/03sep24-bugfixes_topic11148.html"]September[/url]. We still have a lot planned for improving and updating the UI while still remaining true to Illy's retro graphics aesthetic, but we've made a lot of strides in fixing things that were broken.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Server Hardware[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Illyriad Games LTD. made [b]a big upgrade in seriously updating the game’s server and hardware[/b]. If you are tech-minded, you can read about that fun stuff [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/server-move-downtime-04jul24-05jul24_topic11124_page1.html"]here[/url]. One of the reasons why we did this was to vastly increase the [b]capacity to run Faction AI[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Military Unit Movement Speed Increases[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]All units got a racially-inspired speed increase[/b]. We did this for [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/22jul24-military-unit-speed-increases_topic11126_post111533.html?KW=#111533"]unmounted units[/url] last Summer, and updated the mounted units in February. Next up are siege units, which are going to get “raceified” in some interesting, new ways.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Faction-related Content[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27154998/fc830b0204f5019b91f04411e5a79968849b31c2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Faction AI is upon us. The DEVS have been working on it for nearly 3 years, and it is about 90% complete. Along the way, we’ve been launching and updating lots of new Faction-related content, for example:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/22apr22-expanded-interfaction-standings_topic10952.html"]We [b]vastly expanded Inter-factional standings[/b][/url] and default racial standings for all factions, in anticipation for Faction AI.[/p][/*][*][p]We [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/01aug24-eaglesbrood-faction-relaunch_topic11130.html"][b]re-wrote and re-launched the Eaglesbrood faction[/b][/url], debuting new Giant Eagle units onto the map.[/p][/*][*][p]In the biggest content launch in over a decade, [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/30sep24-faction-outposts-launch_topic11153.html"]we placed [b]155 Faction Outposts[/b] on the map[/url], each with their own lore and connected to specific Faction hubs. Those who occupy Faction Outposts will receive a major ranking boost with its corresponding faction, so we’re excited about the PvP/Faction crossover here.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]15-year Anniversary Content Update[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Some of the biggest updates came in February, when [b]the game celebrated its 15th anniversary[/b]. In commemoration, [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/22feb2025-illyriads-15th-anniversary-jubilee_topic11186_page1.html"]we’ve launched [b]a Jubilee year[/b][/url] and have done some exciting things:[/p][list][*][p][b]Launched a Discord server[/b] for players, which is very popular. Y[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]a new “Gigantes” faction race[/b] and put the giants, trolls, ogres, and centaurs into it, separating them from being mere “monsters.”[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://elgea.illyriad.co.uk/#/Alliance/Faction/106"]We [b]made the Cyclopes into their own faction[/b][/url], rather than just being regarded as beasts. They have new lore and will play a key role in Faction AI.[/p][/*][*][p]There was [b]another major IFS and DRS update for Factions[/b], in anticipation of Faction AI. This one was crowdsourced by the players, who came up with some great lore-based rationales.[/p][/*][*][p]This update is also where [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/22feb2025-illyriads-15th-anniversary-jubilee_topic11186_page1.html"]the [b]mounted unit speeds were updated[/b][/url], so you can check out those stats here.[/p][/*][*][p]GM Malek also made [b]a major, racially-inspired update on unit production speeds[/b], decreasing the time it takes to make units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]We launched dragons into the game[/b]. We did this by [url="https://elgea.illyriad.co.uk/#/Alliance/Faction/11"]rewriting the Dragonkin faction[/url] into a dragon-workshipping cult, and launching [url="https://elgea.illyriad.co.uk/#/Alliance/Faction/107"]a straight-up Dragons faction[/url]. There are 5 new, powerful dragon units, as well as deep lore that goes with them. The dragons and giant eagles are arch-enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]We gave every active account [b]an exclusive set of diplomatic Envoy units[/b] — 1 for each race. These will be used to boost rankings with Faction AI.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27154998/c8648e5a223878d19e4f8165a4f4c21e13adbc56.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Dragons Come to Illy[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The debut of the dragons is being very well received, and right now we’re having the [url="https://forum.illyriad.co.uk/15jul25-jubileeyear-fall-tourney-with-dragons_topic11217_post112440.html#112440"]15th Anniversary Jubilee Year Summer Dragon Tournament[/url], where [b]we are giving away dragon units[/b] in the prize pool. We expanded the prize pool so that lots of players win at least one dragon. We anticipate that upwards of 1,000 accounts will be in possession of one by tournament’s end, and the tournament will generate over 100,000 casualties. [/p][p]Also, any player who sends a minimum of 1 troop into combat on a tournament square wil earn [b]an exclusive Dragon Priest military unit[/b] (courtesy of the Dragonkin). These units will have unique and significant value in Faction AI with the dragons.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Dragon Tournament will wrap up at the end of August. From there, we have a string of new content updates planned through the remainder of 2025:[/p][list][*][p]There will be another major Faction/Lore content update coming soon.[/p][/*][*][p]Faction AI's MVP will launch in the Fall. This will be the first new, major system in over 10 years.[/p][/*][*][p]We'll see additional updates on movement speed, this time for siege units.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional, new systems and updates are coming to the combat system as well.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Illyriad is one of the web's oldest and most vaunted MMOPRGs on the web, and its dedication to preserving its sandbox design ethos is the reason why it continues to endure. Now is a great time to get into the game as we continue to support a true Illy renaissance. We'll see you there![/p]

notes.title: Fall Tournament - 2020
notes.content:
From one second into the beginning of the tournament month, through to Midnight on the last day of the tournament month, any member of any alliance in occupation of these squares receives credit for holding the square. Occupation credit and details will be shown on the ingame tournament pages, as usual.

Credit is based on the length of occupation of each square. Time occupied by an alliance on each square counts towards the Alliance total.

This credit is on an alliance basis - individual players cannot receive rewards from participating in these tournaments.

You are not allowed to leave your alliance, or be kicked from your alliance _while you have any armies present_ on one of the Tournament Squares.

All NAPs, Confeds etc are suspended for the duration of this tournament for any military interaction on the Tournament Squares. The Peace of the Camp rule *will not work* on these Tournament Squares.

The alliance that holds each individual regional square for the longest period of time during the tournament month is declared the Regional Winning Alliance for the tournament.

All activity on these tournament squares in each region will also be aggregated, so the top 3 alliances that overall have the most amount of possession across all squares will be the Global Winning Alliances, ranked First, Second and Third.

All tournament activity will be summarised on the tournament pages ingame, as usual.

[h3]THE REWARDS[/h3]

The First, Second and Third Global Winning Alliances will receive a medal customised for their level of victory (Gold, Silver and Bronze respectively), as well as the Season and Year of victory embedded into the medal design.

[img]https://assets.illyriad.net/img/tournaments/Medals/FallMedals.png[/img]

Each Regional Winning Alliance will get to choose a REGIONAL TOTEM - an incredibly powerful and valuable landmark that will operate until a later winner chooses to change it.

[b]Once chosen, each region's totem provides an effect on ALL CITIES located in the entire region, until replaced.[/b]

Please note that - once chosen - the totem CANNOT BE CHANGED UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES until the next regional winner of the next tournament chooses to change it.  

So, to summarize... as the Regional Winner of any one of these tournaments, you can set (or remove) an additional bonus that applies to **all** cities of **all** players in the entire region you won.  That's pretty powerful!

notes.title: Seasonal Tournaments
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Regular Seasonal Tournaments & Regional Totems[/h1]
In honour of Illyriad's 10-year anniversary we're [b]extremely [/b]excited to introduce [i]regular [/i] King of the Hill-style tournaments to Illyriad with a truly worthy reward - [b]Regional Totems[/b]. These totems introduce further potential for long-term, alliance-level, inter-regional, military- and production-based strategies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27154998/567e4e98097ae391befd22ba26fe27ff5fba834c.png[/img]
The Seasonal Tournament runs 4 times a year, every year, covering the entire months of:
[list]
[*] February
[*] May
[*] August
[*] November
[/list]
The tournament squares will randomly move within each region at around 10 minutes after midnight (Server Time - UTC) on:
[list]
[*] 31st January - for the February (Spring) tournament
[*] 30th April - for the May (Summer) tournament
[*] 31st July - for an August (Fall) tournament
[*] 31st October - for a November (Winter) tournament
[/list]

[h2]Tournament Rules[/h2]
These are our signature king-of-the-hill tournaments, one tournament square per region - but with a major addition: totems.

The following rules are the same as they've always been for dev-run tournaments, and you can skip down to [b]The Rewards[/b] section if you're fully aware of how our king-of-the-hill tournaments traditionally run.

From one second into the beginning of the tournament month, through to Midnight on the last day of the tournament month, any member of any alliance in occupation of these squares receives credit for holding the square. Occupation credit and details will be shown on the ingame tournament pages, as usual.

Credit is based on the length of occupation of each square. Time occupied by an alliance on each square counts towards the Alliance total.

This credit is on an alliance basis - individual players cannot receive rewards from participating in these tournaments.

You are not allowed to leave your alliance, or be kicked from your alliance [i]while you have any armies present[/i] on one of the Tournament Squares.

All NAPs, Confeds etc are suspended for the duration of this tournament for any military interaction on the Tournament Squares. The Peace of the Camp rule [i]will not work[/i] on these Tournament Squares.

The alliance that holds each individual regional square for the longest period of time during the tournament month is declared the Regional Winning Alliance for the tournament.

All activity on these tournament squares in each region will also be aggregated, so the top 3 alliances that overall have the most amount of possession across all squares will be the Global Winning Alliances, ranked First, Second and Third.

All tournament activity will be summarised on the tournament pages ingame, as usual:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27154998/2366f3fe79c4bbe5899bb0054f389356ec688755.png[/img]

[h2]The Rewards[/h2]
The First, Second and Third Global Winning Alliances will receive a medal customised for their level of victory (Gold, Silver and Bronze respectively), as well as the Season and Year of victory embedded into the medal design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27154998/a72291b859e42127b12e548515069b581ca0f405.png[/img]
However, the really serious reward here is for each Regional Winning Alliance.

[h2]Introducing Regional Totems[/h2]
Each Regional Winning Alliance will get to choose a REGIONAL TOTEM - an incredibly powerful and valuable landmark that will operate until a later winner chooses to change it.

[b]Once chosen, each region's totem provides an effect on ALL CITIES located in the entire region, until replaced.[/b]

Please note that - once chosen - the totem CANNOT BE CHANGED UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES until the next regional winner of the next tournament chooses to change it.

[h2]The Regional Totems & Bonuses[/h2]
[table]
[tr][th]Totem[/th][th]Name[/th][th]Bonus[/th][/tr]
[tr][td][img]https://assets.illyriad.net/img/tournaments/WoodTotem.png[/img][/td][td]Verdant Growth[/td][td]+10% Wood[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]https://assets.illyriad.net/img/tournaments/ClayTotem.png[/img][/td][td]Earth's Marrow[/td][td]+10% Clay[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]https://assets.illyriad.net/img/tournaments/IronTotem.png[/img][/td][td]Ferric Flow[/td][td]+10% Iron[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]https://assets.illyriad.net/img/tournaments/StoneTotem.png[/img][/td][td]Heart of Stone[/td][td]+10% Stone[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]https://assets.illyriad.net/img/tournaments/FoodTotem.png[/img][/td][td]Cornucopia[/td][td]+5% Food[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]https://assets.illyriad.net/img/tournaments/InactiveTotem.png[/img][/td][td]Inactive Totem[/td][td]No bonuses[/td][/tr]
[/table]
So, to summarize... as the Regional Winner of any one of these tournaments, you can set (or remove) an additional bonus that applies to all cities in the entire region you won. That's pretty powerful!

There will also be a new satellite button off the World Map icon on the top of your screen, which will take you to the Regional Summary page.

This page will summarise (once the first Regional Tournament is completed) the current Regional Winning Alliance, the totem they've chosen, who precisely (in the Regional Winning Alliance) chose the totem, and when it was chosen. There will also be a link to a Regional Detail page, which will summarise the entire totem history for each region. This satellite button and link are not yet live.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]Q.[/b] Wait! This bonus will apply to all cities in the region once it's been chosen?
[b]A.[/b] Yep, all cities - not just those of the Regional Winning Alliance. However, the Regional Winning Alliance gets to make the choice of totem for the entire region.

[b]Q.[/b] If we win multiple regions can we have different totems in each region?
[b]A.[/b] Yes, absolutely! Each region may have different needs, and so it's entirely up to the Alliance making the choice for each region.

[b]Q.[/b] If our alliance wins a region, do we have to make the choice of totem within a certain time period?
[b]A.[/b] No, you don't. If you don't make a choice, then whatever the existing totem is will continue to run for that region until a choice is made, or until the next tournament - where a different alliance might win the region, and wins the right to choose a new totem.

[b]Q.[/b] If our alliance wins a region, who in the alliance gets to make the choice of totem for that region?
[b]A.[/b] Any of the Regional Winning Alliance's SuperUser player accounts will be able to choose the totem for the region after the region has been won.

[b]Q.[/b] Alliance SuperUser X made a mistake in choosing our totem! Can we choose again?
[b]A.[/b] No. This is VERY important; the first Regional Winning Alliance SuperUser who chooses the totem has cast the die for the whole alliance - and for the whole region - [i]until[/i] the next tournament, where they can choose again if they win, or some other winner can choose the totem differently. There's a big "ARE YOU SURE?" popup to confirm the selection. You can't come back to the dev team and say "But we really wanted X totem, this person messed it up!". That's tough luck; and perhaps that person shouldn't be an alliance SuperUser :) Choosing the totem and bonus for [b]all[/b] player cities in the [b]entire[/b] region is a great responsibility, and shouldn't be taken lightly.

[b]Q.[/b] I don't participate in tournaments, why should another alliance have a say in what bonus I get?
[b]A.[/b] This is why the totems are either neutral or positive bonuses, rather than penalties. They have to be this way, because they apply to ALL cities within the region. We don't want to penalise players who, for whatever reason, choose not to participate in a tournament. In the end, everyone either stays resource neutral (if the "Inactive Totem" is chosen)... or they get something distinctly useful, chosen by the Regional Winning Alliance. As a neutral/non-tournament-participant you get [i]status quo[/i] - or upside, but no penalty.

[b]Q.[/b] I'm not a Regional Winning Alliance SuperUser. Why shouldn't I have a say in which totem is chosen?
[b]A.[/b] That's the perk of being a leader of the Regional Winning Alliance. However, we can certainly imagine different alliances may implement their own internally-decided ways of deciding what totem to implement for a particular region - ranging from autocratic self-interest through direct democracy all the way to anarchistic random choice. It's up to the SuperUser of the Regional Winning Alliance to choose the totem for the entire region by whatever method they see fit.

[b]Q.[/b] Why is the February tournament called Spring as that seems more like Winter to me, same with the August tournament for Fall?
[b]A.[/b] This is because the tournaments run for a month before the next Illy season and environmental bonuses kick in. So the change of totem matches the Illy seasons.

The Illy Seasons are:
[list]
[*] Spring is March thru May; so the Spring tournament is held in February
[*] Summer is June thru August, so the Summer tournament in held in May
[*] Fall is September thru November, so the Fall tournament is held in August
[*] Winter is December thru February, so the Winter tournament is held in November
[/list]
[b]Q.[/b] When the quarterly tournament is not running, do these totem squares function as regular tournament squares?
[b]A.[/b] Yes, with one caveat... These squares continue to function as tournament squares with the concurrent suspension of NAPs and Alliances on these squares, in order to facilitate (eg) a player-run tournament or perhaps some 'friendly' inter-alliance combat practice. However, outside of the official Regional Tournament Months, players can quit or be kicked from their alliance, even if they are in occupation of these tournament squares. Please get in touch via petition if this is an issue for a player-run tournament you wish to operate, and we can potentially accommodate.

[b]Q.[/b] Does this mean that the tournament squares are going to rotate reliably every 3 months?
[b]A.[/b] Yes. We think this is a great idea, as sometimes alliances organise their own mini-tournaments or battle practices on the tournament squares, and we've had player-run tournaments in the past. So, having a reliable tournament schedule is important for players to know, so that they can be confident that we won't just rotate the squares in the middle of something they've organised themselves, be that battle practice, or a war.

This means that 4 months of the year are given over to these dev-run Regional Tournaments, and 8 months of the year are provided for interested alliances to run their own tournaments or combat practice on these squares.

[b]Q.[/b] These totem bonuses are great and all, but they're pretty generic resource-driven ones. Will there be more interesting totem bonuses available in the future?
[b]A.[/b] Yep. We're just starting with these ones as proof of concept; but we have plans to introduce different totems with radically different regional effects in the future.

We hope you all enjoy this new feature of Illyriad, and thank you for your continuing support!

Happy 10th Anniversary!

Regards,

GM Stormcrow, GM Cerberus, GM Thundercat

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Its only been out for a few days; but we already have squashed many bugs.
[list]
    [*]Steam Scores and Steam leaderboards now update while you are playing the game; rather than just each time you open the game.
    [*]Steam Achievements are now awarded while you are playing the game rather than each time you launch the game. 
    [*]Score based Steam Achievements are now properly awarded. 
    [*]Mystery/Discovery Steam Achievements are now properly awarded. 
    [*]Many game window resizing bugs are fixed.
    [*]In-game music is back in. You can switch it on and off with the button at top left of the UI:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154998/1708f4ca8f3baab721231be6a5b91762a4f98fc9.png[/img]
    [*]Links in game that are external to game, like forums and help now work and will open in your default external browser.
[/list]
Thank you to our players for the feedback and letting us know about them!
